caption: A pad of steel wool is touched to the terminals of a battery, and sparks race through the wool as its strands glow orange.

sa.check: A pad of steel wool and a battery.
The wool is touched to the battery's terminals.
The strands glow orange and the glow races through the wool.
The wool is dark before the contact.
The contact comes first and the glow follows.

pc.expect: The glow starts at the point of contact with the terminals and runs outward along the strands in branching lines.
pc.fail: The wool is touched to the terminals and stays dark to the end of the clip; or the glow starts at a part of the pad far from the contact; or the whole pad lights at once with no spreading; or the glow appears while the wool is held away from the battery.

pc.expect: The glow spreads one way through the wool; burnt strands go dark and crumble behind the glowing front and do not relight.
pc.fail: The glow retreats back toward the contact; or burnt strands relight; or the glow flashes on and off across the pad; or the pad returns to its unburnt look.

pc.expect: Sparks and burnt fragments that fall off drop downward and go dark; smoke, if any, rises.
pc.fail: Sparks rise and gather above the pad; or hang in the air; or fragments float; or smoke sinks and pools.

pc.expect: The wool is a tangle of fine strands: it compresses under the fingers, and burnt strands thin and crumble to dark specks.
pc.fail: The pad stays a rigid block; or burnt strands stay thick and bright grey; or the pad melts into a pool; or the strands stretch like elastic.

pc.expect: One pad and one battery; the pad stays one tangle, shrinking only as it burns; nothing appears, vanishes or passes through the battery.
pc.fail: A second pad appears; or the pad vanishes in one step; or the pad passes into the battery; or the battery changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The battery's label and the surface beneath stay the same; the glow keeps one orange colour.
pc.fail: The battery's label changes; or the surface changes; or the glow turns blue or green.

note: The hands are kept because they bring the wool to the terminals; the person is otherwise not judged. How far the glow spreads by the end is not judged.
